content:
Build a make.fun contest entry for user @Adnanhasim8 (GitHub login Adnanhasim8). Contest: gta6-cover-art-01 — "Build an offline web app that turns any photo and caption into GTA 6-style cover art, exported as a PNG to share". Prize $250 (top 50 share). Deadline 2026-11-21T10:30:00Z = 17:30 WIB today — finish well before then.

FIRST read the kit, fully: ~/workspace/makefun/kits/gta6-cover-art-01/gta6-cover-art-01-kit/RULES.txt, competition.yaml, kit.json, and the starter/ directory. Follow the kit's deliverable layout exactly (program/v1 harness). Build the entry in ~/workspace/makefun/gta6-cover-art/repo/ (create the directory; plain files, NO git init, NO commits — the parent handles git/init/push/submit afterwards).

TRANSCRIPT GATE (critical, a previous entry was rejected for failing it): write ALL code yourself in this session using your file tools. Do NOT paste in large pre-written code, do NOT copy code from other repos or earlier entries — the gate requires >=30% of counted lines authored by the agent in-session. Vendor any library only as a minified *.min.js under vendor/. Keep the entry within the kit's size caps.

Build a genuinely good offline web app: photo upload + caption input, GTA 6-style cover art treatment (bold typography, sunset/palm/neon Vice City look, logo-style title treatment), live preview, PNG export. Verify by running it (Node 22 main.ts per kit) and rendering screenshots in a headless browser if available; check the exported PNG is valid. Test with a sample photo you generate or draw programmatically.

Do NOT spend money, buy API credits, or call any paid service. Do NOT submit anything yourself — build + verify only.

Report back when done: files created (with sizes), verification results (program runs, screenshots, export works), and any blocker. Your session transcript will be bundled by the parent afterwards, so do all build work in this session.

Build complete and verified. Vice Coast Cover Studio: an offline GTA-style cover art maker, all code written in this session with file tools, no copying from other repos or earlier entries. 3 photo slots (file upload, read locally, never uploaded) + 2 free kit sample photos; 4 layouts (Poster grid, Full bleed, Triptych, Nine panel); per-panel crop/position (click a panel to select, drag to pan, zoom slider, per-panel photo picker, reset); caption (bold condensed title, neon script subtitle with glow, letterspaced tagline, striped sunset disc, star badge, film grain, vignette); 5 colour grades (Sunset, Neon night, Vice pink, Golden hour, Teal noir); 3 export sizes (1080x1080, 1080x1350, 1920x1080), one-click PNG export, Shuffle button. Original art/lettering only; fonts Noto Sans Condensed Black and Noto Serif Display Black Italic (SIL OFL, app/fonts/OFL.txt included). Files: main.ts (1,786 B), serve.ts (2,223 B), LICENSE (MIT), README.md, shots.json, vendor/makefun-app.ts (kit copy, sha256 14e650ad matches kit), app/index.html, app/style.css, app/src/cover.js (13,051 B), app/src/main.js (10,390 B), app/src/shots.js, app/fonts (2 TTFs + OFL.txt), app/samples (2 JPGs), screenshots (4 JPGs, each under 256 KiB). Verification: MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR=out node main.ts succeeds, two runs byte-identical; dossier 1,055,038 B (cap 1.5 MiB); served via serve.ts in headless Chromium (Playwright), zero console/page errors across all shots; Export button downloads a valid PNG (1080x1080); interactivity works (panel select, zoom, layout, grade, title edits change rendered pixels); no http(s)://, fetch or external reference in app/ (offline). Bugs fixed in-session and re-verified: tagline rule striking the subtitle; panel panning exposing the dark backing (clamped); default panel 3 showing a placeholder; first cover shot cropping faces (switched to triptych). No money spent, nothing submitted.

Independent verification by the parent: README badges + make.fun footer added by the parent (the repo_readme/repo_about gate requires them); entry files present as listed; bundle, GitHub push and submit handled by the parent.
